task: Task pipe CLI init resource review

resource_risks.description: The new task pipe command can initialize several external CLI child processes when adapters are configured.
resource_risks.mitigation: Reuse the existing session lifecycle with explicit adapter lookup, bounded prompt/output, timeout, stdin drop, stdout/stderr reader threads, and cancel kill/wait path.

resource_risks.description: Codex, Claude, Gemini, or OpenCode CLI may be missing on the user's machine.
resource_risks.mitigation: Missing adapter commands become capability_missing lane reports and do not block available lanes or the platform shell.

resource_risks.description: The Workspace Monitor UI build must keep the existing static chunk performance budget.
resource_risks.mitigation: Run static build and performance budget after UI changes.

lifecycle_checks.resource: optional external CLI child process per lane
lifecycle_checks.create_path: start_cli_task_pipeline calls create_cli_session for each available lane
lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: cancel_cli_session kills and waits child process; finish path joins stdout/stderr reader handles

measurement_checks.threshold: build exits 0 and emits static UI

notes: No real external CLI child process, long-running daemon, sidecar, PTY, xterm.js, Monaco, or new dependency was launched or installed in this slice.
Rust/Tauri compile remains deferred until a documented Rust toolchain installation audit.
